feasibility_assessment.verdict: NOT DEMONSTRATED IN OPEN LITERATURE; plausible but unproven. No open source read reports a per-reading (Type A) thrust repeatability of <= 0.5 % (~60 µN, 1σ) at 12-25 mN with a 5-20 kg payload.
closest_evidence: Thrust band match, light payload: NASA GRC inverted pendulum, 5-20 mN, 0.9 kg Hall, 1.5 % estimated uncertainty (SRC-POLK2017 citing Manzella 1996).
Thrust band match, payload unknown: MTU null inverted pendulum, 19 mN, 0.411 mN (2.16 %) overall (SRC-KALKMAN2023); Tokyo dual pendulum < 0.25 mN (1.4 %) (SRC-NAGAO2007).

Heavy payload, higher thrust: Xu & Walker ±0.6 % up to 230 mN, 250 kg capacity (SRC-XU2009); Moeller & Polzin 1 mN resolution at 100 mN with 12.1 kg (SRC-MOELLER2010); DLR/AST double inverted pendulum 40 kg / 250 mN, resolution 'well below 1 mN' goal (SRC-DLR-JLSRF2018).
Noise/drift floor, light payload, in air: AST 2 kg balance plateau stability << 0.1 mN at 10 mN and ±250 µN / 27 h (SRC-HARMANN2015).
Hall + ECR on one torsional balance, 3-20 mN (SRC-MASILLO2022) — numbers not accessible.

ESA EPL: load-cell balances '±10 µN' / '0.1 mg ≡ 1 µN' but load capacity 0.5-2.3 kg; ICL hanging pendulum 1-600 mN, '±0.1 mN' (Resolution column), σ < 0.27 mN demonstrated at low thrust (SRC-ESA-EPL, SRC-SCHWERTHEIM2021).
feasibility_assessment.reading: Published absolute uncertainties in the 5-25 mN Hall band are 1.4-2.2 %; the 0.5 % target is a Type A repeatability (not an absolute accuracy), which is a weaker requirement than the published absolute numbers, but no source reports Type A repeatability separately at this thrust with multi-kg payload. The repo's I-U-ABS-T 1 % absolute (PROPOSED) is below every open absolute number found in this band (best 1.4 %).
model_derived_scaling_here: Weight-to-thrust ratio mg/T: 5 kg / 12 mN ≈ 4.1e3; 20 kg / 12 mN ≈ 1.6e4; NASA VF-6 case 1023 (SRC-MACKEY2018), where inclination drift was already a dominant term. For a gravity-coupled pendulum a base tilt γ acts roughly like a force m·g·γ (order-of-magnitude, verify against SRC-POLK2017 Eq. 16): 60 µN corresponds to γ ≈ 1.2 µrad at 5 kg and ≈ 0.31 µrad at 20 kg.

Thermal drift: the 1 kW MPD stand drift ~4.5e-3 mN/s (SRC-YAMASAKI2023) equals 60 µN in ~13 s; a per-reading 60 µN target therefore needs drift rates ~2 orders lower or bracketing zeros on the reading timescale.

Force-standard term negligible: 25 mN ≈ 2.549 g at g_n (R4); E2 mass error 3e-5 relative (R4). Transfer-mechanism terms (pulley friction, monofilament stiffness — SRC-MACKEY2018) dominate calibration.
feasibility_assessment.conclusion: Achievable-per-literature at 12-25 mN with 5-20 kg: ~1-2 % absolute is demonstrated-class; 0.5 % per-reading Type A is at or beyond the published edge and must be demonstrated by the S1a capability demo (CD) on the as-built stand with a dummy payload at the heaviest configuration mass and all SVC-1 lines/shams installed, before LOCK-2 fixes n. If S1a shows u_T > 0.5 %, the lane-25 plan by n (larger n) is the pre-registered lever, not relaxing the target post hoc.
feasibility_assessment.reassessment_after_ESA_lead: Claim narrowed, not overturned. The ESA EPL table does list balances at or below the 60 µN level ('±10 µN', '0.1 mg ≡ 1 µN'), but only for modified commercial weighing load cells with 0.5 kg / 2.3 kg load capacity — incompatible with a 5-20 kg H-1+MC-1+C-1+module stack and (inferred) vertical firing. The ESA ICL balance covering 1-600 mN lists '±0.1 mN' in the Resolution column (uncertainty 'Flexures dependant'); its peer-reviewed validation reports σ better than 0.27 mN at low thrust with a light QCT. Revised statement: no open source read demonstrates <= ~60 µN (1σ) per-reading repeatability at 12-25 mN with a multi-kg (5-20 kg) payload; the best multi-kg-capable numbers found are 0.1 mN resolution (ESA ICL, facility-declared, payload not stated), 'well below 1 mN' (DLR 40 kg class) and 1 mN at 100 mN with 12.1 kg (MSFC). A 0.1 mN-resolution balance would meet the 25 mN target (124.6 µN) but not the 12 mN target (59.8 µN) on a single reading.

dominant_error_terms.why: Polk: compact inverted pendulums vulnerable to heat absorbed from thruster, altering spring constant -> zero and gain shifts; thermal shrouds and active cooling essential; thermal drift generally unavoidable -> frequent recalibration. MTU: temperature a large factor in stable-power drift. Yamasaki: ~4.5e-3 mN/s. Nagao: dual pendulum cancels it.
dominant_error_terms.relevance: H-1 at 1.0-1.35 kW into a 5-20 kg stack; stand must be water-cooled/shrouded; thruster thermally isolated by water-cooled mount (GRC design)

dominant_error_terms.why: Two dominant terms in the NASA VF-6 analysis are stand inclination drift and displacement drift; relative uncertainty scales with mg/T. Tilt from facility distortion at pumpdown and thermal distortion; active leveling required for inverted pendulum.
dominant_error_terms.relevance: mg/T for 5-20 kg at 12 mN is 4-16x the VF-6 case: the dominant error term for a gravity-coupled stand; torsional (vertical axis) response is independent of thruster mass (Polk; INS-01)

dominant_error_terms.why: Sensitivity depends on stiffness of leads and tubing; stranded conductors show non-repeatable tares; cable thermal expansion pushes/pulls stand; remedies: liquid-metal pots, waterfall/cable-harp routing orthogonal to thrust, spring-shaped lines; BUSTLab residual cable force causes null drift.
dominant_error_terms.relevance: Module exchange HW-0/RF/ECR changes the line set unless shams are present (HW-SVC-01); RF coax and microwave waveguide are stiff — Surrey used wireless microwave transfer; per-configuration end-to-end calibration (HW-SVC-02) captures stiffness change but not its drift

dominant_error_terms.why: Inverted/hanging pendulum sensitivity depends on thruster mass (gravity term); torsional response independent of thruster mass.
dominant_error_terms.relevance: Pre-ionizer module mass differs per arm -> sensitivity and natural frequency change; mandatory re-calibration per configuration; counterweight/ballast retune for pendulums

dominant_error_terms.why: Use non-ferrous materials, distance, coax/twisted pair; characterise magnetic tare across coil settings with discharge off.
dominant_error_terms.relevance: MC-1 coils plus ECR module magnets near a null-coil / voice-coil actuator or eddy-current damper

dominant_error_terms.why: Pulley friction moment (spin-down test), monofilament stiffness, calibration alignment angle, local g; voice coil faster/lower variance but may carry systematic error, gravimetric traceable.
dominant_error_terms.relevance: A4 traceability: E2 masses are negligible; the transfer mechanism dominates

dominant_error_terms.why: Vibration generally the dominant disturbance limiting resolution; example 0.025 mm noise on 2.5 mm full scale -> 1 % noise; 12 Hz unknown noise seen at VF-6.
dominant_error_terms.relevance: averaging window per reading vs drift trade

owner_decisions: OD-TS-1 Stand principle: (a) torsional (mass-independent response, lower tilt sensitivity, larger chamber footprint; Surrey Hall+ECR precedent), (b) null-type inverted pendulum with active leveling and water-cooled enclosure (NASA GRC / Xu-Walker lineage, best-documented), (c) double/dual pendulum (DLR/AST 40 kg commercial precedent; Tokyo thermal-drift cancellation). INS-01 open decision 2.

OD-TS-2 Mass on stand (W3): fix the maximum moving mass (H-1 + MC-1 + C-1 + heaviest pre-ionizer module + mount + line terminations) and the spread between HW-0/RF/ECR; the repo does not fix it (the 5-20 kg band is an assumption). This sets mg/T, tilt tolerance and counterweighting.

OD-TS-3 Service-line crossing strategy: liquid-metal pots for DC, cable-harp/waterfall or spring-shaped lines for gas, and how RF coax / microwave feed cross the stand (hard line with shams per HW-SVC-01 vs wireless microwave transfer as Surrey) — decides whether module exchange changes stiffness.

OD-TS-4 Build vs partner vs buy: build to a published basis (GRC/Xu-Walker or Surrey) vs partner with a facility operating a multi-kg mN balance (e.g. DLR STG-ET 40 kg AST balance, Surrey torsional; ESA EPL Corona with the ICL 1-600 mN balance, 80,000 L/s Xe) vs purchase from a manufacturer that has published one (AST) — no vendor or lab contacted; any approach is the owner's call.

OD-TS-5 Calibration principle and traceability: gravimetric pulley/weights (traceable, A4) with or without a voice-coil/electrostatic secondary; the force-standard traceability class is TBD in INS-01.

OD-TS-6 Acceptance test for the stand before LOCK-2: pre-register an S1a capability demonstration of u_T at 12 mN with a dummy payload at maximum configuration mass, all SVC-1 lines and shams installed, H-1-representative heat load, and the drift-correction/zero protocol that will be used in scoring.
OD-TS-7 Whether I-U-ABS-T = 1 % (PROPOSED) stays: open literature in this band shows 1.4-2.2 % absolute; keeping 1 % commits to exceeding published practice.

Neumann 2013 (IEPC-2013-211) and EPJ TI 2021 full text not read: demonstrated performance of the 40 kg DLR/AST balance at 10-25 mN unknown.

Tilt-to-force scaling m·g·γ is an order-of-magnitude derivation here; verify against Polk Eq. (16) for the chosen geometry.
Kokal thesis attributes '< 0.1 % per degree thermal drift' to Harmann 2015; that statement is not in Harmann 2015 (which gives < ±0.1 % FS over 27 h) — do not propagate.

Repo R4 statement 'no commercial mN EP thrust-balance located' should be qualified: SRC-NEUMANN2021 states DLR operates a 40 kg / 250 mN balance 'developed by the company AST'; no datasheet read and no performance at 12 mN found.
